extracted.stage: Financial remedy proceedings; acting for respondent in divorce
extracted.summary: A solicitor enquires about a £38,000 litigation loan for her client, the respondent in divorce financial remedy proceedings, where assets in dispute are around £341,500.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for your client's financial remedy proceedings. We have noted the £38,000 sought and the approximately £341,500 of assets in dispute comprising property and pensions. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and court dealing with the matter, the current stage and any listed hearing dates, a breakdown of the costs to be funded, and details of the assets offered as security together with any existing charges. We will send our criteria and application form, and a colleague will follow up once we have reviewed the information provided.
